title: Sage.js semantic animation and panel export contract

semantic_model.frame_state: Each frame owns a detached PlotSpec or the existing PanelComposition2D.
semantic_model.identity: Frames and layers have stable IDs; panel layer IDs are qualified as <panel-id>.<layer-id>.
semantic_model.immutability: Constructors detach JSON-safe state and all serialization returns detached data.
semantic_model.topology: Every frame must preserve state kind, dimension, panel grid and placement, layer order, layer IDs, and layer kinds.

redraw.reason: Portable correctness for Cartesian, WebGL, and 3D traces takes priority over trace-specific redraw guesses.

controls.autoplay: unsupported because it requires a host lifecycle
controls.loop: unsupported because it requires a host callback

resource_limits.policy: hard validation before Plotly lowering or browser rendering

plotly_lowering.trace_identity: stable semantic layer IDs become Plotly uid values
plotly_lowering.panel_identity: PanelComposition2D qualification and axis binding are reused without a second panel model

export.gif: unsupported; use HTML/JSON or export explicit frames
export.mp4: unsupported; use HTML/JSON or export explicit frames
export.pdf: unsupported by the current graphics export backend

error_codes.SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: The requested output format is outside the supported graphics contract.
error_codes.SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_ANIMATION_FRAME_REQUIRED: A static animation export did not identify one stable frame.
error_codes.SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_ANIMATION_FRAME_INVALID: A frame was supplied for a non-animation export.
error_codes.SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE: A static image backend is not configured.
